# Open Data Product Harness v0.2

ODPH v0.2 defines one Change Package. `graph-change` is the sole conformant package kind. `graph-operation` is reserved for future ODPR-governed work and is deliberately unsupported.

## Canonical resources

- Human-readable specification: /
- Schema source: /odph-v0.2/schema/change-package.yaml
- Derived JSON schema: /odph-v0.2/schema/change-package.json
- Retention graph-change example: /examples/retention-change/change-package.yaml
- Machine-readable document description: /objects.jsonl
- Validation guidance: /validation.html

## Validation boundary

JSON Schema validates shape. The deterministic validator validates package expiry, referenced artifacts, G0/G1 difference, action connection, supplied graph drift, and completion. Maysano remains authoritative for application-time revision, graph state, applied changes, and evidence.
